remarks:
The perfect building lot, ready for your new home! Conveniently located close to two colleges, the villages of Holly, Albion and Medina, Lake Ontario and various parks and recreation.  The Erie canal tow path for biking, walking etc. is just up the road.  This fully approved building lot has been subdivided off an existing farm where there currently is an active apple orchard.  (Seller reserves the right to harvest this years crop)  Many options available for the home of your dreams!  Utilities at the road are electric and public water.  The land has been perced for septic systems and most residents utilize propane for heating in the winter.  Ready to go just apply for your building permit!
Close to: Batavia Downs, both Niagara & Finger Lakes Wine Trail & Erie Canal. SUNY Brockport, Genesee Community College; 45 mins to Rochester & Buffalo and their airports, 45 mins to Darien Lake, slightly over an h0ur to Niagara Falls.
Property being subdivided, taxes to be determined.
